fields.description: Shown on the Pay Now button on the order page.
fields.label: Button Label

fields.description: Starts with sk_test_ or sk_live_. Never expose to the frontend.
fields.label: Secret Key

fields.description: The X-Paystack-Signature header is an HMAC-SHA512 of the request body using your secret key. This field is here in case Paystack ever separates the webhook secret from the API secret. Leave blank to reuse Secret Key.
fields.label: Webhook Secret (optional)
Webhook URL Help
fields.options:
Paste this URL into your Paystack Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks:
https://your-domain/api/method/akwaaba_theme.api.paystack_webhook

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The company under which Sales Orders / Sales Invoices / Payment Entries are created.

fields.label: Auto-complete accounting on payment
fields.description: On a confirmed Paystack payment, submit Sales Order, create + submit Sales Invoice, and create + submit Payment Entry using the accounts below. Uncheck to leave everything in Draft for manual review.

fields.label: MoMo Receiving Account
fields.description: Bank/Cash account credited when a MoMo payment (MTN/Vodafone/AirtelTigo) settles.

fields.label: Card Receiving Account
fields.description: Bank/Cash account credited when a Card payment settles.

fields.label: Direct MoMo (manual — no gateway)
fields.description: Let customers send MoMo straight to your number. Orders wait in 'Awaiting Confirmation' until you confirm the receipt on the Sales Order.

fields.label: MoMo Number
fields.description: The number customers send money to, e.g. 024XXXXXXX.

fields.label: MoMo Account Name
fields.description: The registered name shown when someone sends to this number.

fields.label: Admin Alert WhatsApp
fields.description: Optional. WhatsApp number to ping when a payment needs confirming (best-effort; desk bell alert always fires).

fields.label: SMS Inbox Secret
fields.description: Optional. Shared secret for the momo_sms_inbox endpoint so an Android SMS-forwarder can auto-confirm receipts. Leave blank to keep it manual-only.

fields.label: Extra Instructions
fields.description: Optional extra line shown to customers on the pay screen.
